# Browser dependencies

These files are served locally without a runtime CDN. Retain the license files.

| Distribution | Source | Version / upstream Git blob | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| html5-qrcode.min.js | https://github.com/mebjas/html5-qrcode | package 2.3.8; `18db263dbdc958f63f14c4904cb7e2124c766ecc` | Apache-2.0, html5-qrcode.LICENSE |
| qrcode.min.js | https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs | `993e88f396640f881b69f98db7a4d17401ef83ca` | MIT, qrcode.LICENSE |

html5-qrcode reads QR/barcodes through a camera or an uploaded image. qrcodejs creates printable labels locally. Live camera requires HTTPS (or localhost) and browser camera permission. Scanner USB/keyboard input and uploaded photos are also supported.
